title: BigDog Overview (Updated March 2010)
summary: Boston Dynamics' 2010 demo of BigDog, a quadruped robot that climbs through woods, recovers from kicks, slips on ice and jogs at 5 mph. It was an early showcase of dynamic legged locomotion.
why: Used as the go-to demo of robot resilience when Boston Dynamics comes up.

quote.text: Just how resilient is it? Watch it on ice
